    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Course
    Represents a course assigned to a student.
    JaxbXmlTransformer
    XmlTransformer implementation based on JAXB.
    MarshalingController
    REST controller that starts the XML client.
    MarshallingApplication
    Entry point of the marshalling application.
    Student
    Represents a student with personal data and a list of assigned courses.
    Students
    Root object of the XML document that holds the list of students.
    XmlClient
    Socket client that receives the students XML from XmlServer.
    XmlServer
    Socket server that sends the students as XML on port 8383.
    XmlServerRunner
    Loads the students from the XML file on startup and sends them through XmlServer.
    XmlTransformer
    Transforms Students objects to XML and back.
